review.notes: Price unrealistic: the same aluminium laptop stand + phone stand combo sells for Rs 349-404 (TARKAN 2-in-1) and Rs 499 (GADGETSWEAR) on Amazon.in; Rs 899 is roughly double. The model is loss-making at Rs 599 (-4% Amazon) and below, and the combo also needs two suppliers (two parcels) unless one stocks both.
